parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The ingest domain name to query.
- You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
- If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domain names is returned by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC. >You can query data from the last **90** days.
